channel.title: Riiid on Jungbae Park
channel.description: Recent content in Riiid on Jungbae Park

item.title: Prompt-Aware Speech Scoring System for Second Language Learners
item.description: Developed a prompt-aware automatic speech scoring system at RIIID that solves the cold-start item problem using BERT/CLIP prompt embeddings. Published at InterSpeech 2023 and deployed to SANTA Say TOEIC Speaking app.

item.title: Knowledge Tracing with Contrastive Learning
item.description: Proposed ACCL and RCL contrastive learning methods at RIIID, achieving state-of-the-art on student modeling across 6 benchmarks (dropout prediction, knowledge tracing). Deployed to Santa TOEIC platform.

item.title: ML Model Registry, Dataset Pipeline & Infrastructure at RIIID (뤼이드)
item.description: Built ML model registry (MLFlow) and dataset pipelines (Airflow, Athena, BigQuery) at RIIID, serving 4+ products including SANTA TOEIC, IVYGlobal SAT, CASA GRANDE, and INICIE.

item.title: ML Pipeline Acceleration & Multi-GPU Training at RIIID (뤼이드)
item.description: Introduced RIIID’s first multi-GPU training, boosting GPU utilization from 25% to 95% and cutting initialization time from 1 hour to 10 seconds. Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
